source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    tiles = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1], col_bounds[j] + 1, col_bounds[j + 1])
             for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1) for j in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]
    vals = [grid[r][c] for r0, r1, c0, c1 in tiles for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
    bg = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    nr, nc = len(row_bounds) - 1, len(col_bounds) - 1
    out = [[bg for _ in range(nc)] for _ in range(nr)]
    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(nc):
            r0, r1, c0, c1 = tiles[i * nc + j]
            pts = [(r, c) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] != bg]
            if any((r + 1, c) in pts or (r, c + 1) in pts for r, c in pts):
                out[i][j] = 1
    return out
'''
